# forward_collector (Resource)

Registers a collector with Forward and returns the token it runs with. Forward shows the token only at registration, so it is kept in state and cannot be recovered after an import. Destroying this deletes the collector in Forward.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Register a collector and attach it to a network. The token is what the
# collector runs with (the Docker collector's TOKEN); Forward shows it only
# here, at registration.
resource "forward_collector" "aws" {
  name = "aws-us-east-1"
}

resource "forward_collector_attachment" "prod" {
  network_id = "123456"
  username   = forward_collector.aws.username
}

resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "collector_token" {
  secret_id     = aws_secretsmanager_secret.collector_token.id
  secret_string = forward_collector.aws.token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Collector name, unique in the organization. Changing it registers a new collector.

### Read-Only

- `app_server_url` (String) Forward server the token was issued for, when Forward includes it in the token (newer token format); null otherwise.
- `id` (String) Forward's collector ID.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The collector's auth token as `username:password`: the `TOKEN` the collector container takes. Null for an imported collector.
- `username` (String) The collector's username (`collector-xxxxxxxx`), as `forward_collector_attachment` takes it.
